name: Spare the Dying
description: You touch a living creature that has 0 hit points. The creature becomes stable. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.
effect: Touch a fallen ally and they get back up at 1 HP. Cast on someone still standing, the next blow that would drop them leaves them at 1 HP instead.
notes: In combat (bonus action): a downed ally gets back up at 1 HP; anyone still standing is warded: the next blow that would drop them leaves them at 1 HP.
